items.name: all
items.title: All
items.description: Installs every Orchid UI component via registryDependencies (including toast). all.tsx only re-exports Toaster and toast for the app root.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: Class-name helper (cn). Merge Tailwind classes. Import from @/lib/utils, not as a UI widget.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary actions: save, cancel, delete, icon-only, split menus. variant Primary|Secondary|Destructive. Native HTML type is type=submit|button|reset (default button). style Default|Border|Transparent, size Small|Default|Big. Not tabs or links in a nav.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Overflow or grouped actions on a trigger (Edit, Delete, filters). Use DropdownMenu + Trigger (render Button) + Content + Item. Not for choosing one value from a long list — use select.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: In-page notification above the page header: title, description, actions, close. color Default|Blue|Red|Orange|Grey. Not a floating toast.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Programmatic floating toast. toast.add({ title, description, type: 'success'|'info'|'warning'|'error' }). Not sonner toast(). Mount Toaster at the app root. Not an in-page alert.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status, tags, filters, removable tokens. Badge colors + style Background|Border|Transparent. UserBadge role Owner|Admin|Manager|Cashier. Not a button.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expand/collapse sections (FAQ, extra details, progress per item). AccordionTrigger title/description/label/progress. Not tabs — use tabs for switching views.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Show completion of a known total (70/100, upload, wizard). size Default|Small, value/max. Not a loading spinner for the whole page.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: Generic list row. Compose title, media, logo, meta, copy fields, tokens, hover actions. layout default|stack|media. selected highlights the card. Not a data table.

items.name: quantity-input
items.title: Quantity Input
items.description: Integer quantity (capacity, count). Minus/plus; click the number to type. min/max/step. Not a slider and not a plain text input for money.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Person or business face. size 24–64, variant Default|Business|Image. Initials as children; src for a photo. Pair with names, not as a logo block.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover/focus hint on an icon or truncated label. TooltipProvider + Content side. Not a popover with buttons — use popover or dropdown-menu.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch views on one page (Week | My shifts | Review). variant Default underline or Pills. TabsList + TabsTrigger + TabsContent. Not a dropdown of actions.

items.name: choice-card
items.title: Choice Card
items.description: Pick one option as a card (plan, shift slot, payment method) without a radio dot. ChoiceCardGroup. Not a checkbox list and not select.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: Dashboard KPI: icon, title, value, percent badge. iconColor Blue|Green|Red|Grey. Grid several on a home/overview page. Not a list row — use list-item.

items.name: page-toolbar
items.title: Page Toolbar
items.description: Top bar on a nested screen: Back or Close + right-side buttons. Put page-title below, not inside. Not the app sidebar.

items.name: page-title
items.title: Page Title
items.description: Page heading: title, optional chip/status, description, copy id, action buttons. Sit under page-toolbar; detail-list below. Not a card title inside a list.

items.name: form-section
items.title: Form Section
items.description: Form section heading: 16px title, 12px description, optional chip, hint, count, and actions. Pair with Field/Input via FormSectionGroup; settings rows use FormSectionItem. Not a page heading — use page-title.

items.name: detail-list
items.title: Detail List
items.description: Read-only key/value details (shift time, customer fields) in one card. style Default or Border table. Grid + colspan. Not an editable form — use field + input.

items.name: icon-group
items.title: Icon Group
items.description: Tight cluster of icon actions (copy, open link, more menu). style Default|Border. Not a full toolbar of labeled Buttons.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy a string (id, phone, URL) with a Copied! tooltip. Pass value. Use on ids and contact fields, not as the only way to duplicate a whole record.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Path to the current page. BreadcrumbList + Item + Link + Page + Separator. Use Link href or app router Link as the anchor. Not PageToolbar back.

items.name: customer-card
items.title: Customer Card
items.description: Customer or beneficiary summary: name, email, phone, address, avatar. variant Small|Big|Float|Empty. Empty + onAdd when none selected. Not a generic user list row — use list-item for long lists.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Multi-select yes/no options (permissions, extras). CheckboxGroup Vertical|Horizontal. For one on/off setting use switch. For one-of-many use radio-group or select.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Exactly one choice from a short list (alignment, role). Radio inside RadioGroup. For many options use select; for cards use choice-card.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off setting (notifications, publish). size Default|Small. Not a checkbox in a form list of many items.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or range on a track (0–100, price band). Array value = two thumbs. Not for counts with exact integers — use quantity-input.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: No data / no search hits / upgrade CTA. variant Default|Search|Upgrade + actions Buttons. Use when a list or page has zero rows — not for inline field errors. Not CustomerCard Empty.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label next to a control (htmlFor). Prefer FieldLabel inside Field for forms.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visual divider between blocks. orientation horizontal|vertical. Use instead of hr or border-t divs.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder bars. Pulse on oc-neutral-soft. Shape via className (size-8 rounded-full, h-4 w-full). Not a spinner.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading (save, refresh). size Small|Default|Big. Not Skeleton (layout placeholder) and not Progress (known percent).

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form row: label, control, hint, error. FieldGroup + Field + FieldLabel. data-invalid on Field, aria-invalid on the input. Wrap every form control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text (name, email, amount as text). Use with Field. Prefix/icon → input-group, not a positioned Button.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line notes (issues, leftover work, description). Use with Field. Not for chat transcripts.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one from a list (status, staff, currency). Select + Trigger + Value + Item. Inline size for currency inside input-group. For many values with search, use combobox. Not radio cards — use choice-card.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable list (tags, staff, countries). Combobox + Input + Item. Multiple: ComboboxChips + ComboboxChip. Checkbox variant and ComboboxSelectAll for bulk pick. Grouped: Group + Label + Collection. Not a closed single pick without search — use select.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command palette. CommandDialog + Command + CommandInput + CommandList + CommandItem. onSelect(value). Not Combobox in a form.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard shortcut keys. Kbd and KbdGroup. Use next to Close, command palettes, and shortcut hints.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One expand/collapse panel (filters, extra fields). Collapsible + Trigger + Content. Several independent sections: Accordion.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Custom scrollbar in a bounded panel (Sheet body, long lists). Native overflow is fine for the page. ScrollBar orientation vertical | horizontal.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input plus prefix, suffix, or inline select (currency, URL, search icon). InputGroupInput/Textarea inside — never raw Input. Addon align start/end.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Small panel on click (date, extra filters) that is not a full modal. Trigger render Button. For hover hints use tooltip; for page dialogs use modal.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid only. Prefer date-picker for forms. Use calendar when you embed a month in a custom layout. mode single|range|multiple.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Pick a day or a date range in a form (shift date, week range). DatePicker or DatePickerRange. Not a full-page calendar widget.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Focused task overlay. Dialog + DialogTrigger + DialogContent (packed: title, optional footer). No DialogHeader/Footer/Title exports. size Small|Medium|Default|Confirmation|Fullscreen. persistent = no backdrop close. Not a side sheet.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Edge panel complementary to the page (edit row, filters). Sheet + Trigger + Content. side Right|Left|Top|Bottom, size Small|Medium|Default. Packed title/footer like Dialog. Not a centered Dialog. Not a swipe Drawer (keep app drawer for mobile snap/swipe).

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Prebuilt confirm overlay on Dialog. type Delete|Warning|Success|Question. Warning confirm is Continue (not Delete). size Small|Medium. Optional confirmPhrase to type before delete. Use ConfirmDialogContent as the inner block.

items.name: schema-form
items.title: Schema Form
items.description: JSON schema form on TanStack Form. Field keys: showIf, maxLength, hidden. Types: input, password, textarea, select, combobox, radio, checkbox, checkbox-group, accepted, switch, slider, input-group, date, quantity, object, section, section-item, hidden, phone. Pair keys with key+ for input-group. Import SCHEMA_FORM_EXAMPLE_FIELDS.
